Responsible-AI-Deployment-Framework.title: Responsible AI Deployment Framework
Responsible-AI-Deployment-Framework.problem: A bank wants to release an AI-powered customer advisory assistant and needs a defensible way to decide whether it is ready for production.
Responsible-AI-Deployment-Framework.approach: Scores the system across seven responsible AI domains (privacy, fairness, transparency, security, accountability, reliability and safety, human oversight) with a weighted formula, readiness thresholds and risk-based approval gates.

Enterprise-AI-Risk-Assessment.title: Enterprise AI Risk Assessment
Enterprise-AI-Risk-Assessment.problem: A financial services company needs an inventory of its AI systems and a single, repeatable method for rating the risk each one carries.
Enterprise-AI-Risk-Assessment.approach: Builds a 5×5 likelihood and impact methodology, applies it across a 10-system AI inventory, and completes impact assessments aligned with NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001.

eu-ai-act-article-16-provider-compliance.title: EU AI Act Article 16: provider compliance programme
eu-ai-act-article-16-provider-compliance.problem: A provider of a high-risk credit-scoring system must meet all twelve Article 16 obligations before placing it on the EU market.
eu-ai-act-article-16-provider-compliance.approach: Turns each legal obligation into practical actions with a named owner and the evidence that proves it was met.

dataflow-soc2-readiness.title: DataFlow Analytics: SOC 2 Type II readiness
dataflow-soc2-readiness.problem: Fortune 500 customers of an AI-powered BI platform now require SOC 2 Type II attestation as a contractual obligation.
dataflow-soc2-readiness.approach: Working as Compliance Manager: designs controls against the Trust Services Criteria, collects evidence, tests the controls and tracks findings through remediation before the observation period.

gdpr-compliance.title: EuroShop GmbH: GDPR compliance programme
gdpr-compliance.problem: A retailer processing personal data for more than three million customers across 27 countries needs a working GDPR programme.
gdpr-compliance.approach: Working as Data Protection Officer: maps processing activities, identifies risks, designs controls against GDPR articles and sets up the policies that govern them.

AWS-Security-Assessment-and-Hardening.title: AWS security assessment and hardening roadmap
AWS-Security-Assessment-and-Hardening.problem: An AWS environment needs a clear view of its security posture and a prioritised path to harden it.
AWS-Security-Assessment-and-Hardening.approach: Inventories assets, records findings, rates the resulting risks and maps remediating controls to CIS and NIST CSF.

Generative-AI-Security-Risk-and-Governan.title: Generative AI security, risk and governance assessment
Generative-AI-Security-Risk-and-Governan.summary: Translates GenAI and LLM risks into guardrails, controls, owners, evidence and test plans: a 12-risk register, control catalogue, AI tool inventory and executive remediation roadmap.
